skills/qc-core/scripts/qc.py.invariant: compute_verdict is the single verdict algorithm; presence P0 blocks even when fixed; atomic_write_json uses temp+fsync+replace
skills/qc-core/scripts/qc.py.assumptions: callers pass a list of finding dicts and the correct p0_policy; dest directories are writable
skills/qc-core/scripts/qc.py.sequence_risk: read-modify-write of a ledger is safe because replace is atomic; two writers last-write-wins

skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_ledger.py.invariant: verify() fail-closes on missing or non-JSON ledgers and recomputes verdict via qc.compute_verdict
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_ledger.py.assumptions: schema file is readable or jsonschema is optional; qc-all ledgers may state SKIPPED/READY without local recompute
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_ledger.py.sequence_risk: calling verify then overwrite is the documented loop; mismatch is a ledger bug not a script bug

skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_skills.py.invariant: landing checks run only when README.md and docs/qc-core.pdf exist at pack root; vendored sibling layouts skip them
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_skills.py.assumptions: SKILLS_DIR is the parent of qc-core; glob qc-*/ finds every specialization next to it
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_skills.py.sequence_risk: running landing checks then skill-contract checks: missing README must not abort the remaining registry

skills/qc-core/scripts/partition.py.invariant: reexam_set is changed files plus import-graph neighbors already in hot_spots/pass_debt; mixed-language groups are forbidden
skills/qc-core/scripts/partition.py.assumptions: git is available for --since; profile JSON is well-formed or the CLI fail-closes
skills/qc-core/scripts/partition.py.sequence_risk: truncated profile then --reexam must print FAIL not traceback (including NameError on sys)

skills/qc-core/scripts/suite_rollup.py.invariant: unreadable ledgers fail closed; suite_verdict comes only from qc.suite_verdict
skills/qc-core/scripts/suite_rollup.py.assumptions: findings-dir contains LEGAL_ORDER json files or they are listed in skipped
skills/qc-core/scripts/suite_rollup.py.sequence_risk: corrupt ledger then rollup must not emit a partial _rollup.json

skills/qc-core/scripts/write_ledger.py.invariant: write_ledger.py only writes via qc.atomic_write_json; junk stdin/src fails closed
skills/qc-core/scripts/write_ledger.py.assumptions: dest parent is creatable; stdin is a JSON object
skills/qc-core/scripts/write_ledger.py.sequence_risk: partial stdin then write must not replace dest with truncated JSON

skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_port.py.invariant: verify() reports every missed planted finding; unreadable expected/ledger/profile fail closed
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_port.py.assumptions: expected.json uses file_substring/severity/what_contains; clean artifacts have substantive invariants
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_port.py.sequence_risk: bad expected path then --ledger must not traceback

skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_profile.py.invariant: hardening EXAMINED rows require Carmack 5Q or invariant+assumptions+sequence_risk; closed deferred codes only
skills/qc-core/scripts/verify_profile.py.sequence_risk: verify then render: render must not treat a failing profile as authoritative markdown

skills/qc-core/scripts/render_profile.py.invariant: render_profile.py is generated output; JSON is source of truth; unreadable profile fail-closes
skills/qc-core/scripts/render_profile.py.assumptions: profile keys used by render are optional with empty defaults
skills/qc-core/scripts/render_profile.py.sequence_risk: missing profile then --out must not write a truncated markdown file

skills/qc-all/references/scripts/append_.invariant: history appends one JSON line then trims to max-lines via temp+replace; malformed rollup exits 1
skills/qc-all/references/scripts/append_.assumptions: history path parent is writable; rollup has run_id and git_sha
skills/qc-all/references/scripts/append_.sequence_risk: crash between append and trim can leave one extra line; next run trims

hot_spots.rationale: Landing checks assumed pack-root README; vendored sibling layout crashed
unguarded JSON ingest plus missing sys import on the error path

pass_debt.why_missed: Pass 3 inventories FileNotFoundError on read_text per file but did not look at the second parent directory used when qc-core is vendored next to specializations
Pass 3 fixed suite_rollup.json.load but did not grep the same unguarded json.loads ingest in render_profile, verify_port, partition, and write_ledger

invariants.statement: verify_skills landing checks run only when README.md and docs/qc-core.pdf sit at the pack root; a vendored sibling layout skips them and still finishes skill-contract checks
Every qc-core JSON ingest CLI fail-closes on OSError or ValueError with FAIL on stderr and a non-zero exit; it does not traceback

maintainability_trend.rationale: Landing checks and JSON ingest assumed the pack checkout and well-formed files. A vendored install or truncated profile forced whole-script context (verify_skills abort; partition NameError). Local fail-closed fixes, no architecture change.
